name: Ben Sira
contribution: A Hellenistic Jewish scribe, sage, and allegorist from Seleucid-controlled Jerusalem of the Second Temple period.
image_credit: Workshop of Jörg Breu the Younger · Public domain

checks.lead: Simon Ben Jesus Ben Eliezer ben Sira, better known as Ben Sira, also called Ben Sirach, Jesus ben Sira, Jeshua ben Sira, or Sirach (Hebrew: שמעון בן יהושע בן אליעזר בן סירא, romanized: Šīmʿōn ben Yəhōšuaʿ ben ʾĔliʿezer ben Sirāʾ‍; fl. 2nd century BCE) was a Hellenistic Jewish scribe, sage, and allegorist from Seleucid-controlled Jerusalem of the Second Temple period. He is the author of the Book of Sirach, also known as "Ecclesiasticus".
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
